<meta charset="UTF-8">

<title>Archestra Customer Signal Board</title>
<style>
  :root{
    --bg:#0c0b11; --panel:#151327; --panel2:#1c1834; --ink:#f5f3fb; --warm:#efe9df;
    --muted:#a49ec2; --muted2:#7d769c;
    --purple:#8b5cf6; --purple-deep:#6d28d9; --lime:#c6ff3d; --lime-deep:#a3e635;
    --border:#2a2647; --border-hot:#3d3566;
    --sec:#ff8fa3; --infra:#7dd3fc; --dx:#c6ff3d; --collab:#c4b5fd; --obs:#fbbf72; --aiops:#a5f3d0;
    --r:18px;
  }
  *{box-sizing:border-box}
  html,body{margin:0}
  body{
    color:var(--ink); font-family:'Inter',system-ui,-apple-system,Segoe UI,Roboto,sans-serif;
    background:
      radial-gradient(900px 480px at 88% -12%, rgba(139,92,246,.22), transparent 62%),
      radial-gradient(720px 460px at -4% 112%, rgba(198,255,61,.08), transparent 58%),
      var(--bg);
    background-attachment:fixed; min-height:100dvh; padding:24px 20px 48px;
  }
  .wrap{max-width:1080px;margin:0 auto;position:relative}

  /* header */
  header{display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
  .htext{max-width:640px}
  .eyebrow{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lime);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:10px}
  .eyebrow .dot{width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
  h1{margin:0;font-size:clamp(23px,3.2vw,31px);font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.02em;line-height:1.12}
  .sub{margin:6px 0 0;color:var(--muted);font-size:14px;line-height:1.45}
  .demo-btn{border:1px solid var(--border-hot);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--ink);font-weight:700;font-size:13px;padding:11px 18px;border-radius:12px;cursor:pointer;transition:.16s;white-space:nowrap;font-family:inherit;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
  .demo-btn:hover{border-color:var(--lime);color:#fff}
  .demo-btn svg{width:15px;height:15px}

  /* summary labels */
  .summary{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}
  .chip{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:12px;font-weight:600;color:var(--muted);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:8px 13px;border-radius:999px}
  .chip .d{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%}
  .chip .d.hot{background:var(--lime)} .chip .d.grow{background:var(--purple)} .chip .d.clar{background:var(--obs)}

  .layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:18px}

  /* board */
  .board{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px}
  .sig{position:relative;text-align:left;border:1px solid var(--border);background:linear-gradient(168deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));border-radius:var(--r);padding:16px;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .16s,border-color .16s,box-shadow .16s;font-family:inherit;color:var(--ink);overflow:hidden;min-height:132px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px}
  .sig::before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:var(--cat,var(--purple));opacity:.85}
  .sig:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:var(--border-hot);box-shadow:0 16px 32px -18px rgba(139,92,246,.6)}
  .sig.selected{border-color:var(--lime);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px var(--lime),0 16px 32px -18px rgba(198,255,61,.4)}
  .sig.active{border-color:var(--purple)}
  .sig.glow{animation:glow 1.4s ease}
  @keyframes glow{0%,100%{box-shadow:0 0 0 1px transparent}40%{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--lime),0 0 26px rgba(198,255,61,.45)}}
  .sig-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:8px}
  .sig-ic{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid var(--border-hot);flex:none}
  .sig-ic svg{width:18px;height:18px}
  .sig-sel{width:20px;height:20px;border-radius:6px;border:1.5px solid var(--border-hot);display:grid;place-items:center;flex:none;transition:.15s}
  .sig.selected .sig-sel{background:var(--lime);border-color:var(--lime)}
  .sig-sel svg{width:12px;height:12px;opacity:0;transition:.15s}
  .sig.selected .sig-sel svg{opacity:1}
  .sig-title{font-size:14.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.25;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  .sig-meta{margin-top:auto;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .pill{font-size:10.5px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.03em;padding:3px 9px;border-radius:999px;text-transform:uppercase}
  .pill.cat{color:var(--cat,var(--purple));background:color-mix(in srgb,var(--cat,var(--purple)) 14%,transparent);border:1px solid color-mix(in srgb,var(--cat,var(--purple)) 30%,transparent)}
  .pill.sig-label{color:var(--muted);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border)}

  /* side panel */
  .scrim{position:fixed;inset:0;background:rgba(6,5,12,.6);backdrop-filter:blur(2px);opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s;z-index:30}
  .scrim.show{opacity:1;pointer-events:auto}
  .panel{position:fixed;top:0;right:0;height:100dvh;width:min(430px,94vw);background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));border-left:1px solid var(--border-hot);box-shadow:-30px 0 70px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.8);transform:translateX(102%);transition:transform .32s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1);z-index:31;display:flex;flex-direction:column}
  .panel.show{transform:none}
  .panel-head{padding:22px 24px 16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}
  .panel-body{padding:20px 24px;overflow-y:auto;flex:1}
  .panel-close{position:absolute;top:16px;right:16px;width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border-hot);background:var(--panel);color:var(--muted);cursor:pointer;font-size:17px;line-height:1;display:grid;place-items:center}
  .panel-close:hover{color:#fff;border-color:var(--lime)}
  .panel .p-ic{width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:12px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid var(--border-hot);margin-bottom:12px}
  .panel .p-ic svg{width:22px;height:22px}
  .panel h2{margin:0;font-size:19px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;line-height:1.25}
  .panel .p-pills{display:flex;gap:7px;margin-top:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .sect{margin-top:20px}
  .sect h3{margin:0 0 8px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--lime);font-weight:700}
  .sect .q{font-size:15px;font-weight:600;line-height:1.4;color:var(--warm)}
  .sect p{margin:0;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.55;color:var(--muted)}
  .sect ul{margin:0;padding:0;list-style:none;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:7px}
  .sect li{font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.4;color:var(--ink);display:flex;gap:9px;align-items:flex-start}
  .sect li::before{content:"";width:6px;height:6px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--purple);margin-top:6px;flex:none}
  .owner{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;font-size:13px;font-weight:700;color:var(--ink);background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border-hot);padding:8px 14px;border-radius:10px}
  .owner .d{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--lime)}
  .panel-foot{padding:16px 24px;border-top:1px solid var(--border)}
  .add-btn{width:100%;border:0;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit;font-weight:800;font-size:14px;padding:14px;border-radius:13px;color:#160c02;background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--lime),var(--lime-deep));transition:.16s;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px}
  .add-btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
  .add-btn.added{background:var(--panel);color:var(--lime);border:1px solid var(--lime);cursor:default}
  .add-btn.pulse{animation:addpulse .5s ease}
  @keyframes addpulse{45%{transform:scale(1.03)}}

  /* action plan */
  .plan{border:1px solid var(--border);background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.02),transparent);border-radius:22px;padding:20px}
  .plan-head{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:6px}
  .plan-head h2{margin:0;font-size:17px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em}
  .plan-head .hint{font-size:12.5px;color:var(--muted2)}
  .plan-actions{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .mini{border:1px solid var(--border-hot);background:var(--panel2);color:var(--ink);font-family:inherit;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;padding:9px 14px;border-radius:10px;cursor:pointer;transition:.15s;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:7px}
  .mini:hover{border-color:var(--lime)}
  .mini.primary{background:linear-gradient(180deg,var(--purple),var(--purple-deep));border-color:transparent;color:#fff}
  .mini.primary:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
  .empty{text-align:center;color:var(--muted2);font-size:13.5px;padding:26px 10px;line-height:1.5}
  .groups{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:14px}
  .group{background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:12px;min-height:80px}
  .group h4{margin:0 0 10px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;font-weight:700;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:7px;color:var(--muted)}
  .group h4 .d{width:7px;height:7px;border-radius:50%}
  .group.clarify h4 .d{background:var(--obs)} .group.create h4 .d{background:var(--lime)} .group.validate h4 .d{background:var(--purple)}
  .item{background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border-hot);border-radius:11px;padding:11px;margin-bottom:9px;animation:pop .28s ease}
  @keyframes pop{from{opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px) scale(.98)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
  .item .it-title{font-size:12.5px;font-weight:700;line-height:1.3;margin-bottom:8px}
  .item .it-row{display:flex;gap:6px;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .item select,.item input{font-family:inherit;font-size:11px;border-radius:8px;border:1px solid var(--border-hot);background:var(--panel);color:var(--ink);padding:5px 7px}
  .item input{flex:1;min-width:90px}
  .item select{cursor:pointer}
  .prio{font-size:10px;font-weight:800;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.04em}
  .it-x{margin-left:auto;background:none;border:0;color:var(--muted2);cursor:pointer;font-size:15px;line-height:1;padding:2px 4px}
  .it-x:hover{color:var(--sec)}

  /* final */
  .final{border:1px solid var(--border-hot);background:linear-gradient(160deg,var(--panel2),var(--panel));border-radius:22px;padding:24px;margin-top:18px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;display:none}
  .final.show{display:block;animation:pop .4s ease}
  .final::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;opacity:.8;background:radial-gradient(240px 180px at 88% -20%,rgba(139,92,246,.28),transparent 60%),radial-gradient(220px 160px at -6% 120%,rgba(198,255,61,.14),transparent 58%)}
  .final>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
  .final h2{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:22px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:-.01em;background:linear-gradient(92deg,#fff,var(--lime));-webkit-background-clip:text;background-clip:text;color:transparent}
  .final .fsub{color:var(--muted);font-size:13.5px;margin:0 0 18px}
  .fsum{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-bottom:18px}
  .fbox{background:rgba(255,255,255,.03);border:1px solid var(--border);border-radius:14px;padding:14px}
  .fbox .fl{font-size:10.5px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--muted2);font-weight:700;margin-bottom:9px}
  .tagrow{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:6px}
  .tg{font-size:11px;font-weight:700;padding:4px 9px;border-radius:999px;background:var(--panel);border:1px solid var(--border-hot);color:var(--ink)}
  .final .result-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:4px}

  .footer-note{margin-top:26px;text-align:center;font-size:11.5px;color:var(--muted2);line-height:1.5;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap}
  .footer-note svg{width:13px;height:13px;opacity:.7;flex:none}
  .pubtag{position:fixed;left:14px;bottom:12px;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--muted2);background:rgba(21,19,39,.8);border:1px solid var(--border);padding:5px 11px;border-radius:999px;z-index:20;backdrop-filter:blur(4px)}

  /* guided demo */
  .coach{position:fixed;z-index:45;background:var(--lime);color:#160c02;font-weight:700;font-size:12.5px;padding:10px 14px;border-radius:11px;box-shadow:0 14px 30px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.6);max-width:230px;line-height:1.35;opacity:0;transform:translateY(6px);transition:.2s;pointer-events:none}
  .coach.show{opacity:1;transform:none;pointer-events:auto}
  .coach .cx{display:block;margin-top:8px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;text-decoration:underline;cursor:pointer;opacity:.8}
  .toast{position:fixed;left:50%;bottom:24px;transform:translate(-50%,10px);background:var(--panel2);border:1px solid var(--border-hot);color:var(--ink);padding:11px 20px;border-radius:12px;font-size:13px;font-weight:600;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:.25s;z-index:60}
  .toast.show{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}

  @media (max-width:880px){.board{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.groups{grid-template-columns:1fr}.fsum{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
  @media (max-width:560px){.board{grid-template-columns:1fr}header{align-items:flex-start}}
</style>

Here's **Customer Call Bingo**.

Want to change the app? Tell me how!

Want to use the app? Use the UI 👉, or ask me to!

enhancement.description: Bingo card that fills as customer calls hit common phrases and escalations.
enhancement.prompt: Build me an app that shows a bingo board of my customer call transcript topics and phrases, filling in cells as they come up live, with a reset button and a counter for how many bingos we've hit so far.
enhancement.response:
Customer Call Bingo is built — a bingo game for spotting recurring phrases and moments during customer calls. It includes:
- A 5×5 bingo board filled with common call patterns like “Let me transfer you,” “Can you hold?,” or “I need to escalate.”
- A “New Card” button that shuffles the phrases into a fresh layout for each call.
- Tapping a square marks it as heard, with a visual checkmark and color change.
- Automatic win detection when a full row, column, or diagonal is completed — with a celebratory message.
- A reset button to clear the board and start a new round.
To play, just click any square when you hear that phrase on a call. Mark five in a row to win!
